_note: Registry of open datasets for Krey twin validation + calibration. Raw images are NOT committed (see data/.gitignore) — fetch with scripts/fetch_datasets.sh into data/<key>/. Rationale + verdicts: docs/skin_data_plan.md. Skin tone is deterministic (app/monk.py, CIEDE2000) so these feed VALIDATION/CALIBRATION, not training — except hair-texture, the one classifier worth training (no labels here yet).

indicfairface.name: IndicFairFace
indicfairface.purpose: Indian-face corpus: validate owner-pick/recognition + inspect the tone distribution / off-swatch rate our reader produces across diverse Indian faces. No tone ground truth.
indicfairface.access: git clone the repo; dataset via the Google Drive link in its README (use gdown).

dermacon_in.name: DermaCon-IN
dermacon_in.purpose: PRIMARY Indian Monk/Fitzpatrick reference: calibrate the LAB->Monk mapping on our actual population (MST 6-7 centred). Caveats: dermatology sites not faces; lesion/condition confounds on colour.
dermacon_in.access: Kaggle CLI: kaggle datasets download hiro002/dermacon-in-dataset (needs kaggle token).

scin.name: SCIN (Skin Condition Image Network)
scin.purpose: Secondary Monk-label cross-check of the LAB->Monk mapping (larger, but US population). Use after DermaCon-IN.
scin.access: GCS bucket gs://dx-scin-public-data (gsutil) or the google/scin HuggingFace mirror.

fairface_onnx.name: fairface-onnx
fairface_onnx.purpose: Optional auxiliary attribute model. Coarse race/age/gender; does NOT replace ArcFace identity and does NOT read skin colour.

iiscifd.name: IISc Indian Face Dataset (IISCIFD)
iiscifd.purpose: SKIP for Krey: grayscale (no colour for tone) + non-commercial (can't ship).

kaggle_adityakammati_skintone.name: Kaggle SkinTone-Dataset (adityakammati)
kaggle_adityakammati_skintone.purpose: SKIP/low: coarse class labels, not Monk, not Indian-specific, wrong tool for a continuous read.

kaggle_usamarana_skintone.name: Kaggle Skin Tone Classification Dataset (usamarana)
kaggle_usamarana_skintone.purpose: SKIP: 3 coarse classes (not Monk), not Indian.
